subject: Post-call: Northwind - window needs, token profile & pricing next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Shaw <emma@northwind.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Northwind - window needs, token profile & pricing next steps

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side and a short list of asks so we can size a pricing pilot that maps to your economics: 

Recap (call highlights)
- Use case: multi-turn incident summarization + long-document KB retrieval for customer support agents.
- Expected burstiness: daily peak windows during US business hours (650-800 agents), background nightly batch processing.
- Priority: keep latency under 400ms p95 for interactive paths; batch can be higher latency.

What we need to finalize a pilot + target economics (can reply inline)
1) Typical per-call token mix: avg prompt tokens, avg completion tokens (please provide both means and a 90th percentile if available).
2) Monthly / quarterly token volume estimate (separate interactive vs batch if you have it).
3) Fraction of calls that need longer context windows: % needing >8k, % >32k, % >128k.
4) Target unit economics: do you have a target $/1M tokens or budget range for pilot production?
5) Any regulatory restrictions (data residency, encryption/HSM) we should include in an SOW.

I attached the call notes and a short template for token-profile input. If it's easier, you can paste numbers below and we'll fold them into a costing model and propose a 3-month pilot with clear milestones (quality guardrails + rollback).

Next steps (proposed)
- You: send token averages + monthly volumes + window percentages (itemized).
- Us: return a pilot proposal with pricing tiers and an example $/1M token target aligned to your mix.
- Procurement: if pilot looks good, we can push an SOW + PO template.

Attachments: northwind-postcall-notes.pdf (call notes), token-profile-template.xlsx (in Drive link)

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Emma Shaw <emma@northwind.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@northwind.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Northwind - window needs, token profile & pricing next steps

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the clear recap. Below are the numbers I can share immediately; I've included what we can export from prod for the last 30 days and rounded where appropriate. Happy to pull more granular percentiles if helpful.

Token profile (30-day sample)
- Avg prompt tokens (interactive): 220 tokens (p90: 480)
- Avg completion tokens (interactive): 540 tokens (p90: 1,200)
- Avg prompt tokens (batch/nightly): 1,800 tokens (p90: 6,400)
- Avg completion tokens (batch/nightly): 3,400 tokens (p90: 9,500)

Context window needs
- % calls needing >8k context: 2.1% (mostly batch/document re-runs)
- % calls needing >32k context: 0.15% (rare legal/contract summarizations)
- % calls needing >128k context: ~0% (we don't have any production calls hitting that today)

Token volumes (monthly estimate)
- Interactive: 120M tokens/month (prompt + completion combined)
- Batch: 230M tokens/month (large-document processing)
- Total: ~350M tokens/month

Budget / target economics
- We are looking to pilot at an effective target of ~$420 / 1M tokens (aspirational), but procurement will push for lower; open to a tiered structure tied to committed volumes.

Compliance notes
- Data residency: US only for this business line.
- We will need SOC2 attestation and encryption at rest + in-transit; HSM/KMS integration preferred.

If you want, I can attach the raw export (CSV) for the 30-day sample — procurement prefers summary PDFs, though.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Shaw
Head of Data Platforms, Northwind AI Labs
emma@northwind.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Shaw <emma@northwind.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Northwind - window needs, token profile & pricing next steps

Emma — thanks for the great detail. Based on the profile you sent, here's our recommended pilot structure to validate performance and economics while protecting both sides.

Pilot proposal (high level)
- Duration: 90 days
- Committed tokens (month 1-3): 50M / 100M / 150M (ramp) — split interactive vs batch as you see fit.
- Pricing approach: blended tiered pricing with separate unit rates for interactive (low-latency) vs batch (higher throughput, lower cost). Example target outcomes:
  - Interactive: $560 / 1M tokens (guaranteed p95 latency SLOs)
  - Batch: $280 / 1M tokens (throughput-optimized paths)
  - Blended example for your mix (~120M interactive + 230M batch) -> effective ~ $360 / 1M tokens.

Notes on context windows
- For the ~2% of calls >8k we recommend enabling a 32k-compatible runtime for both interactive and batch during the pilot (no changes required to your ingest). We can selectively route those calls to a higher-capacity model and metric them separately.
- 128k support not needed at pilot stage; we can evaluate later for long-contract workflows.

Deliverables before kickoff
1) Pilot SOW + SLAs (we'll draft and share).
2) Pilot pricing spreadsheet (attached) with line-item math and a projected invoice example for month 1/2/3.
3) Integration checklist (KMS + VPC peering if needed).

I've attached a starter pricing model (northwind-pricing-model.csv) and a draft SLA (redwood-sla-draft.docx). 

If that looks reasonable, Hannah will coordinate procurement timing and signatures; I recommend we set a tentative kickoff week-of-Apr 18 so we have time for PO and technical onboarding.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: procurement@northwind.ai

Subject: Re: Post-call: Northwind - window needs, token profile & pricing next steps

Hannah —

Procurement here. Thanks for the proposal — please send the following to move forward:
1) Draft SOW + pricing spreadsheet (final numbers assumed after legal review).
2) Standard Master Services Agreement or redline candidate.
3) DocuSign-ready SOW (we prefer electronic signature).
4) Billing contact and PO template.

We reviewed the target economics internally; $420 / 1M is a starting point — we'll expect some flexibility during the pilot.

Please route documents to procurement@northwind.ai and copy Emma. We'll aim to turn around a draft PO within 7 business days once the SOW is approved.

Thanks,
Northwind Procurement Team
procurement@northwind.ai
